svg.title: JVM Memory: String Pool (StringTable) vs Heap & intern()
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing String s1 literal pointing to the String Pool entry, String s2 allocating a distinct Heap String wrapper sharing the same Compact String byte array, and s2.intern() resolving back to the pooled reference so s1 == s2.intern() is true.
svg.text: JVM Memory: String Pool (StringTable) vs Heap & intern()
Java 9+ Compact Strings: shared immutable byte[] backing array & canonical pool lookup
